why: IKS-Instruct is a named, released dataset rather than a general instructional element or method.
name: IKS-Instruct dataset
product_description: A released multilingual dataset of 24,795 instruction-response pairs for fine-tuning and evaluating language models on Indian Knowledge Systems pedagogy, created and released by Shwetha Singaravelu and colleagues.

why: The IKARion architecture is a narrower implementation of learning-analytics-driven feedback, using group interaction data to trigger targeted feedback and scaffolding rather than introducing a distinct instructional element.

rejected.verifier: The claim concerns distinguishing group clusters via coordination activity, not predicting at-risk learners or delivering targeted feedback, so linking it would require an extra inferential step.
